dishes.name: Pani puri
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of Indian pani puri chaat. Six crisp round hollow semolina puris on a dark slate plate, each filled with spiced white peas and drizzled with green mint coriander water, topped with fine yellow sev and chopped coriander. A small steel bowl of green pani beside them. No raw onion garnish.

dishes.name: Masala puri
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of Indian masala puri chaat. Crushed crisp puris in a shallow steel bowl under a warm spiced white pea gravy, finished with fine yellow sev, chopped coriander and swirls of tamarind and green chutney. No raw onion garnish.

dishes.name: Bhel puri
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of Indian bhel puri. Puffed rice tossed with crisp papdi shards, tamarind and green chutney, fine yellow sev and fresh coriander, heaped in a paper cone on a dark plate with a wedge of lime. No raw onion garnish.

dishes.name: Sev puri
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of Indian sev puri. Six flat crisp papdi discs on a dark plate, each spread with chutney, drizzled with tamarind and green chutney and buried under a thick heap of fine yellow sev and chopped coriander. No raw onion garnish.

dishes.name: Dahi puri
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of Indian dahi puri. Six crisp hollow puris on a dark slate plate, each filled and crowned with thick whisked white yoghurt, tamarind chutney, green chutney, fine yellow sev and pomegranate seeds. No raw onion garnish.

dishes.name: Samosa chaat
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of Indian samosa chaat. A crisp golden samosa broken open on a dark plate, smothered in warm spiced chickpea ragda, whisked yoghurt, tamarind and green chutney, fine yellow sev and coriander. No raw onion garnish.

dishes.name: Ragda pattice
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of Indian ragda pattice. Two shallow fried golden patties on a dark plate under a ladle of warm white pea ragda, finished with tamarind chutney, green chutney, fine yellow sev and coriander. No raw onion garnish.

dishes.name: Burger
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of a vegetarian burger. A toasted sesame bun with a thick golden crumbed vegetable patty, crisp lettuce, a slice of tomato and a smear of sauce, on dark slate beside a paper wrap.

dishes.name: Cheese burger
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of a vegetarian cheese burger. Toasted sesame brioche bun, thick golden crumbed vegetable patty, a slice of melting cheddar draping over the edge, crisp lettuce and tomato, served on dark slate beside a paper wrap.

dishes.name: Peri peri burger
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of a vegetarian peri peri burger. A toasted bun with a golden crumbed vegetable patty coated in bright red peri peri spice, melting cheese and crisp lettuce, dusted with red chilli flakes, on dark slate.

dishes.name: Veg sandwich
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of an Indian veg sandwich. White bread layered with green coriander chutney, cucumber, tomato and beetroot slices, cut into triangles and stacked on a dark plate. No onion.

dishes.name: Toast sandwich
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of an Indian grilled toast sandwich. Thick bread pressed on a grill with deep golden griddle bars, cut diagonally to show a spiced vegetable and cheese filling, stacked on a dark plate with green chutney beside it.

dishes.name: Cheese chilli toast
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of Indian cheese chilli toast. Thick white bread slices under a blistered golden layer of melted mozzarella flecked with green chillies and cracked black pepper, cut into triangles on a dark ceramic plate, faint steam rising.

dishes.name: Veg frankie
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of an Indian veg frankie roll. A soft paratha rolled tight around a spiced vegetable filling, half wrapped in white paper, standing upright on a dark board with one end cut open to show the filling.

dishes.name: Veg cheese frankie
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of an Indian veg cheese frankie roll. A soft paratha wrap rolled tight around a spiced vegetable and grated cheese filling, half wrapped in white paper, one end cut open to show the filling, standing upright on a dark board.

dishes.name: Butter dabeli
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of Kutchi butter dabeli. A soft pav bun pressed on a buttered griddle, filled with dark spiced masala, topped with ruby pomegranate seeds, roasted peanuts and fine yellow sev, served on a dark plate.

dishes.name: Cheese dabeli
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up food photography of Kutchi cheese dabeli. A buttered pav bun griddled golden, filled with dark spiced masala under a thick layer of melting grated cheese, topped with pomegranate seeds, roasted peanuts and fine yellow sev, on a dark plate.

dishes.name: Classic margherita
dishes.brief: Photorealistic overhead food photography of a classic margherita pizza. Thin hand stretched base with a blistered leopard spotted crust, bright red tomato sauce, molten mozzarella pooling, fresh basil leaves scattered on top, on a dark metal pizza tray.

dishes.name: Four cheese
dishes.brief: Photorealistic overhead food photography of a four cheese pizza. A thin hand stretched base with a blistered golden crust under four molten cheeses pooling and browning in patches, cracked black pepper on top, on a dark metal pizza tray.

dishes.name: Peri peri
dishes.brief: Photorealistic overhead food photography of a peri peri vegetarian pizza. A thin hand stretched base with a blistered crust, red peri peri sauce, molten mozzarella, strips of red and yellow capsicum and a dusting of chilli flakes, on a dark metal pizza tray.

dishes.name: Tandoori
dishes.brief: Photorealistic overhead food photography of a tandoori paneer pizza. A thin hand stretched base with a blistered crust, molten mozzarella, cubes of orange red tandoori marinated paneer, capsicum strips and fresh coriander, on a dark metal pizza tray.

dishes.name: Mint mojito
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up drink photography of a mint mojito mocktail. A tall glass of pale green soda over crushed ice, packed with muddled mint leaves and lime wedges, condensation beading down the glass, a mint sprig and a straw on top.

dishes.name: Blue lagoon mojito
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up drink photography of a blue lagoon mojito. Tall glass of vivid electric blue soda over crushed ice, muddled mint leaves and lime wedges suspended in the glass, condensation beading down the side, a straw and a mint sprig on top.

dishes.name: Sunset
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up drink photography of a sunset mocktail. A tall glass with a graded pour running from deep red at the base through orange to gold at the top, over ice, an orange slice and a cherry on the rim, condensation on the glass.

dishes.name: Guava shots
dishes.brief: Photorealistic close up drink photography of Indian guava shots. A row of small shot glasses filled with thick pale pink guava juice, rims dusted with red chilli and black salt masala, a wedge of fresh guava beside them.
